development_feature_policy.candidate_predictors: Only B41A-preregistered objective usage, snap-share and historical production signals from frozen B41B cohort

frozen_target.b41b_nflverse_future_components_use: leakage/audit witness only; not substituted for exact custom scoring
frozen_target.primary_target: mean frozen-league-scored fantasy points per active game over the next four active games, transformed to an origin-week within-position midrank percentile
frozen_target.target_source_if_validation_passes: Sleeper historical weekly raw stats scored by the frozen B41C scorer

candidate_1.name: best_single_signal_baseline
candidate_1.selection: single eligible normalized signal with lowest outer-CV MAE

candidate_2.fit: nonnegative coefficients; intercept allowed; squared-error objective with L2 regularization
candidate_2.hyperparameter_selection: nested leave-one-training-season-out CV inside each outer fold
candidate_2.name: nonnegative_ridge_linear

candidate_3.fit: HistGradientBoostingRegressor with nondecreasing monotonic constraints on every admitted signal
candidate_3.hyperparameter_selection: nested leave-one-training-season-out CV inside each outer fold
candidate_3.name: monotonic_hist_gradient_boosting

model_family_preregistration.outer_validation: leave-one-season-out cross-validation; each season held out once

model_selection.complexity_rule: one-standard-error rule on outer-fold MAE; choose simplest model statistically indistinguishable from the lowest-MAE model

scorer_validation.failure_action: scientific STOP; a new versioned scorer must be preregistered before any model fitting
scorer_validation.validation_truth: Sleeper league matchup players_points under current custom scoring
